name: r-applied-analysis
description: Research-editable descriptive, regression and complex-survey analysis in R with explicit estimands and uncertainty.

interface.shortDescription: Transparent research analysis and survey inference in R.
interface.longDescription: Describe research data, compare groups, fit ordinary linear and generalized linear models, and preserve complex-sampling inference with survey. Keep specifications, diagnostics and interpretable results together.
defaultPrompt: Describe these outcomes and estimate the prespecified group comparison with explicit missing-data denominators.
Fit and interpret this regression, keeping the model and diagnostics locally editable.
Estimate this survey domain's mean and uncertainty using its weights, strata and clusters.
